sortBy.description:
JSON specifying sort criteria.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. Currently supported sorts are:

+ id: Sort by primary key

+ created_at: Sort by group creation datetime

+ updated_at: Sort by the time the group was updated last (operations: list)

select.description: Comma separated list of properties to include. (operations: list)

name.description: The new group name. (operations: create, update)

id.description: Group id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete, get, update)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
